assets.name: Bola de liaison
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single isolated raster effect for a detailed hand-painted 2D fighting game set in Death Stranding 1, to replace the game's existing Canvas effect. This is a gameplay visual adaptation, not a new official weapon. ONE effect per image, entire effect visible and centered with generous 15% transparent padding on all sides, sharp small-scale readability. High detail tactile materials, restrained cinematic lighting. Subject: ONE flying strand binding bola, a thin braided tan-gold binding cable stretched into an open horizontal loop, two compact weighted dark metallic ends, each about one eighth the loop width. A sense of rightward travel, cable loop trails gently left. Practical utilitarian material appropriate to Sam's nonlethal strand equipment, no gun, no hands, no other object. The loop stays mostly horizontal, width roughly three times its height. No oversized sci-fi sphere, flames, lightning, text or logo. Genuine alpha outside the cable and weights, including the hole inside the loop; no background, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard.
assets.official: Bola Gun canonique; silhouette et animation de projectile adaptées pour la lisibilité 2D.

assets.name: Marée noire
assets.prompt: Edit the referenced transparent game effect. Preserve the same material, black glossy supernatural tar, tiny subdued gold fingertips and realistic hand-painted detail. Recompose this ONE connected group of FIVE rising tar hands into a TALLER AND NARROWER silhouette for an existing fighting-game hitbox. Exact art-direction target: visible silhouette HEIGHT should be 1.16 times its visible WIDTH (for example 1000 pixels tall by 860 pixels wide), excluding transparent padding. The center hand reaches full height. Both intermediate hands reach roughly 85 percent of center height; both outer hands reach roughly 65 percent. Keep narrow upright forearms and clearly distinct natural fingers, crowd the five wrists close together and join them into ONE COMPACT NARROW tar puddle. Do not extend the puddle sideways beyond the outer fingertips. Slightly overlapping silhouettes are acceptable, but all five palms must remain recognizable. The shape is a single tall nearly rectangular eruption, not a wide triangular fan. Flat side-view game asset, centered, full effect inside the frame, roughly 10 percent empty transparent margin each side. Real alpha transparency outside and between the fingers, with no visible background haze, gray glow rectangle, floor shadow or scenery. No person, no flesh or gore, no labels, no multiple variants. This changes only the composition to fit the game's existing visual attack volume; it is not a new canonical weapon.
assets.official: Motif de goudron et de mains inspiré des Échoués; technique Marée noire créée pour le fan-game.
